sensors.name: line tracker brightness (light % of the floor under it)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the floor under the line tracker is darker than 70 %, drive forward at 40 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight on where there is no line (through a dark tunnel without touching its walls), and follow the line again after it.

decision_points.condition: the brightness under the line tracker is less than 70 %

branches.outcome: darker than 70 % (on the black line): it drives forward at 40 %
70 % or brighter (no line under it): it goes on to look for an obstacle

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead of the front sensor

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
nothing is ahead: it goes on to follow the line

decision_points.condition: the line tracker sees black under it

branches.reason: black is darker than 70 %, so the same reading already made it drive forward in driveInTheDark: this branch is never reached

scenarios.coded_response: It drives forward at 40 % and keeps going straight.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the black line, facing along it.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker finds the floor under it darker than 70 %.
scenarios.title: Follows the black line
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to; you didn't say what happens there.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the black line to its end.

scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is on the plain floor with no line under it, a wall ahead of it.
scenarios.trigger: The obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall when it is off the line
assumptions: You didn't say what it should do at a wall; the goal comes from your stop-at-a-wall step, and you said it shouldn't touch walls.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops before the wall without touching it.

scenarios.coded_response: With nothing ahead and no black, it curves right in a small circle.
scenarios.initial_condition: There is no black line under the robot and nothing in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees the plain floor, not black.
scenarios.title: No line under it: drives straight on
assumptions: You said this about a dark tunnel; the program can't tell a tunnel from open floor, so 'no line under it' is the trigger.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: Where there is no line it drives straight on, without touching anything.

uncertainties: You said the robot should drive through a dark tunnel, but the program reads only the brightness of the floor under the line tracker, never the light sensors: dim light changes nothing it reads, so it cannot tell it is inside a tunnel.
In followLine, 'sees black: curve left' can never happen: the same black reading already sent it forward at 40 %.
On the plain floor it curves right in a circle of about 6 cm radius, so it never gets through a tunnel on its own.
